visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium close-up of a young woman with dark hair in pigtails, wearing a dark brown t-shirt. She is smiling broadly and holding three plush toys: a Hello Kitty with a surfboard, another with a hula skirt, and a third in a pineapple costume. They all have distinctive tanned/brown skin. The background is a brightly lit retail environment with shelves. Glowing pink and white text overlays appear at the top. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor shot at night. The woman is standing in front of an 'ABC STORES' location with a prominent blue glowing sign. She points upward towards the sign and speaks directly to the camera. The street background is slightly blurred with warm artificial lights from nearby shops. (3) A sequence of quick cuts shows various 'ABC STORES' and 'MAHALO ABC STORES' signs from different angles, emphasizing the frequency of the locations. The woman is seen walking and gesturing towards the storefronts. (4) Inside the store, the camera focuses on a display of Sanrio plushies. The woman's hands enter the frame to pick up and show different characters: Hello Kitty in various outfits, My Melody, Kuromi, and Pochacco, all featuring the signature tanned Hawaii-exclusive look. Each plush is held close to the lens for detail. (5) Close-up shots of price tags and promotional signs for the 'Hello Kitty 50th Anniversary' collection are shown. The woman continues to cycle through different characters, including a white Cinnamoroll and a yellow Gudetama, comparing them to the tanned versions. (6) In the final phase, the woman stands inside the store holding four selected plushies. She smiles at the camera, gesturing with the toys. Social media handle overlays and 'like/follow' prompts appear on the left side of the screen as she concludes her presentation.
